access_contract: Authenticate identity separately from profile completion, app-role membership and approval status. Authentication never self-approves operational access.
Use only existing app authentication methods. Do not invent MFA, forced email verification, invitation, admin self-registration or phone OTP for Delivery/Admin.
Represent signed out, identity verification, checking access, incomplete profile, pending review, rejected, suspended/deactivated, denied role and failed access read separately where supported.
Indeterminate checking never claims an approval percentage or ETA. Failed lookup means unknown access, not confirmed rejection, suspension or missing application.
Pending review explains the affected workspace, supported actions and no guaranteed result. Refresh is a read; resubmission is a distinct permitted mutation.
Suspension is not pending, rejection, sign-in lockout or offline status. Show safe reason only if authorised and present; do not invent appeal or unlock actions.
Only existing rejection/pending correction paths can expose application editing. Suspended/deactivated users cannot regain work access by editing locally.
Verification fields omit sensitive sample values. Runtime handles paste/autofill, secure password visibility semantics, change-number, safe errors and server-governed resend/cooldown.
Async operations retain account/route ownership, block duplicate taps and ignore stale results after sign-out or account change. No old-user profile or protected-shell flash.
Accessible headings, labelled inputs/actions, live checking/error announcements and focus recovery are target requirements needing rendered AT tests; raster is not proof.
Return to an authorised intended destination only after the actual profile and access checks. Back never grants access or silently submits an application.
Reuse shared AuthService and existing app gate/feedback/design equivalents; migrate presentation deliberately without weakening backend/rules authorization.
implementation_status: Design assets/docs only. No app/package runtime, pubspec, navigation or backend changed by this task.
